title: executive-daily-priorities-maya-2026-03-04
content:
Daily scratchpad - Maya Chen (quick, not polished)
Date: 2026-03-04

Top 3 for today:
1) Exec sync prep (9:30) - align on Dedicated SKU rollout timing + messaging. Need final numbers from finance by 8:30.
   - Ask finance for worst/best case ARR uplift (Ben) - reminder sent 07:45.
   - Draft slide with timeline + fallback plan if infra tops out.
2) Customer escalation: Acme Health (SLA/latency) - triage + next steps with SRE (Lina). Goal: agree on short-term mitigation by EOD.
3) Approve Q2 hiring plan for infra (people ops loop) - finalize headcount and job descriptions.

Meetings / talking points:
- 09:30 Exec sync (30m)
  - 2 min: state headline (Dedicated launch date still T-6w; have 3 blockers)
  - Finance (Ben) to present ARR scenarios (2 slides)
  - Ops (Lina) to confirm capacity and fallback policy
  - Ask: decision on go/no-go on Promo window for early adopters

- 11:00 Product deep-dive (hosted-api & optimize)
  - Need to push model-catalog rollout to canary next week; call out risks with quantized model regressions
  - Ask PD to own a short eval plan for top-10 customers

- 14:00 Acme Health war room (internal)
  - Gather logs, recent deploys, and tracing (SRE to pull)
  - Customer call scheduled 16:00 - propose mitigation (traffic shaping + fallback to older model)

Follow-ups / action items (quick list):
- [ ] Ben: ARR uplift scenarios by 8:30 (DONE?)
- [ ] Lina: Confirm node pool autoscale settings + temporary quota bump (in progress)
- [ ] Eng: Snapshot of rolling deploy timeline (ask release-eng)
- [ ] Legal: Review customer data access for Private deployment for Acme (CC: Sarah)
- [ ] DE: finalize developer onboarding checklist for Dedicated customers

Weekly goals (this week):
- Finalize Dedicated beta invite list and SLA tiers.
- Ship first iteration of cost-optimizer suggestions in Redwood Optimize (beta).
- Close 3 enterprise POCs on Dedicated capacity.

Quick notes / brain dump:
- Messaging: lead with reliability and cost predictability; save tech details for follow-up.
- Potential comms risk if we promise specific latency numbers before canary tests complete. Flag to Marketing.
- Consider a customer-facing KB entry for model fallback behavior (Ops + Docs).

Parking lot / longer-term:
- Revisit regional routing policy for APAC expansion (Q3).
- Executive report: include token-level cost breakdown by model family next month.

Unresolved questions:
- If Dedicated beta fills faster than expected, what is our policy for prioritizing existing commitments vs new customers? (Need playbook)
- Can we offer temporary credits to Acme Health while we patch? Ops + Finance decision.

Useful links/refs:
- Confluence: ENG - Dedicated rollout plan (link above)
- Jira: INF-1423 (Acme Health latency triage)
- PR: github.com/redwood-inference/rfcs/pull/78 (proposal for routing policies)

Notes to self: keep bullet points short for exec sync; call out risks, ask, and decision needed.

End of scratchpad.
